svg.text: JS08633: target STTC - contrastive IG with three competitor rules (median A-vs-B similarity among eligible pairs; label for STTC: ABSENT)
Rule A: competitor SVT (margin M = 1.33) - red raises M, blue lowers; same colour scale in all three
Rule B: competitor WPW (margin M = -0.64) - red raises M, blue lowers; same colour scale in all three
Rule C: competitor LVH (margin M = 2.37) - red raises M, blue lowers; same colour scale in all three
colour scale +/-0.356 logit units per 20-sample block. Maps describe the MODEL's sensitivity, not a physiological cause.
